generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other conditions as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: To qualify for award of this contract the tenderer in his name should have the work done certificate of Construction of new buildings like House, Complexes, Godown etc., for the previous three years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 for minimum amount of 50% of similar kind of estimated cost of the present work issued by the DCF/Executive engineer/above rank officers.

The bidder shall submit a Turnover certificate issued by Charted Accountant confirming an annuau turnover of not less than the estimated cost of work put to tender for each of the last three preceeding financial years.i.e 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Income Tax Returns for previous three years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)
GST Registration certificate & GST return filing for previous three years (2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26)

Liquid assets and / or a variability of credit facilities of not less than 30% of the tender estimate cost credit/Letter of Credit/Certificates from Banks for meeting the fund requirement for work costing.
Address proof (Aadhar Card/EPIC card/Driving license/pass port/ bank pass book or any other documents issued by competent government authority.
Notary Affidavit stating that bidder is not black listed by any Government Agency/Department
Tenderer should produce valid class III and above PWD contractor registration certificate.
